target_applications: academic/industrial research: mobile manipulation, bi-manipulation, HRI, AI/ML, healthcare, assisted living, robotics competitions

base_type.value: wheeled; differential drive (TIAGo/++) or omnidirectional 4x mecanum (OMNI/OMNI++)

weight_kg.source: https://pal-robotics.com/datasheet/tiago/ (baseline figure; dual-arm config heavier, est. 75-85 kg)

dof_total.source: https://pal-robotics.com/datasheet/tiago/ (dual-arm: 2x7 arms + 1 torso + 2 head + 2 base, before end-effectors; gripper +2, Hey5 hand +19)

reach_mm.source: https://pal-robotics.com/datasheet/tiago/ (87 cm arm reach w/o end-effector; SEA arm option 96 cm)

battery_kwh.source: https://pal-robotics.com/datasheet/tiago/ (36 V 20 Ah; second battery optional)

runtime_h.source: https://pal-robotics.com/datasheet/tiago/ (4-5 h one battery; 8-10 h two batteries)

actuators.value: brushless/brushed DC motors with current-feedback (sensorless torque control); optional SEA arm (2023) with joint torque sensing, brakes, 1 kHz EtherCAT

end_effector.value: PAL parallel gripper (default), PAL Hey5 5-finger hand (19 DoF, 3 actuated), Robotiq 2F-85 / 2F-140, ePick vacuum; interchangeable

media_at_flange.value: plug-and-play end-effector interface; optional 6-axis wrist F/T sensor; user mounting points + USB on head/tray/base

sensors_head.value: RGB-D camera, 2x microphone array (stereo, 50-8000 Hz), 2x 5 W speakers

sensors_wrist_hand.value: optional 6-axis F/T sensor at wrist; actuator current feedback in all joints; fingertip sensors optional (Hey5)

sensors_base.value: front laser (Hokuyo 5.6 m or SICK TiM561 10 m/25 m), 3x rear sonars (1 m), IMU; OMNI++ has 2x LiDAR with 360 deg FoV

compute.value: Intel i5 8 GB/250 GB SSD (upgrade i7 16 GB/500 GB); optional NVIDIA Jetson (TX2 historically, current Jetson add-on); Wi-Fi 6

software_stack.value: Ubuntu LTS + RT-Preempt, ROS LTS (Noetic), ROS 2 packages actively released (Humble); open-source Gazebo sim, MoveIt, ros_control, Whole Body Control, web GUI/visual programming, Advanced Grasping package

safety_compliance.value: e-stop, current/torque-limited arms, admittance control with F/T sensor, brakes in SEA arm option; no public CE/ISO 13482 certification statement (n/a)

price.value: TIAGo++ from ~EUR 90,000 (2019, config-dependent); current pricing quote-based

availability.value: shipping worldwide since 2019 (++)/2021 (OMNI++); direct quote-based sale; free ROS simulation available

deployment_evidence.value: 40 collaborative projects, 14 EU countries, 27 countries worldwide (vendor); RoboCup@Home 2019 winner platform (Homer team); EU projects EnrichMe, OpenDR, CANOPIES; unit counts not disclosed

notes: Modular family: LITE (no arm), TIAGo (1 arm), ++ (2 arms), each with diff-drive or OMNI mecanum base. height_mm is max (torso raised); min 1100 mm. runtime_h given for single battery (max 10 h with two). Discovery-note '€50k-class' price applies to single-arm configs; dual-arm ++ started ~EUR 90k (2019).
